summary: dlab_workshop exfiltrates installer credentials and environment secrets to attacker collaborator host
details: index.js is registered as both preinstall and postinstall in package.json and is also the package main, so its top-level executePayload() runs on npm install and on require. The payload reads installer credential files from the user's home directory (~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, ~/.ssh/config, ~/.npmrc, ~/.gitconfig, and.env files), enumerates process.env for keys matching API/KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/PASS(WORD)/DB/MONGO/REDIS/AWS/GITHUB/SLACK/WEBHOOK/AUTH/CERT/PRIVATE, walks the working directory for.js/.json/.env and config/secret/key/credential-named files, reads.git/config, and collects hostname/username/cwd/argv. Collected data is base64-encoded and sent to the hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain xvw7xrftj6a1npnpcs2557r78yep2lqa.oastify.com via HTTP GET and POST. The package's own source comment labels itself as a malicious payload.
